activity.statutory_purpose: Oppføring av bygg, bygging av eiendommer, eiendomsutvikling. Oppfølging av byggearbeider, snekkerarbeider, entreprenør, rehabilitering av boliger, anleggsarbeid, muring, tømrerarbeider, maling, taktekking og alt som følger naturlig av denne bransjen. Rådgiver av bygge og oppføring. Import og eksport av bygningsmaterialer, handel med verktøy og byggevarer. Annen forretningsmessig tjenesteyting ikke nevnt annet sted og andre produkter som naturlig faller sammen med dette, herunder å delta i andre selskap med lignende virksomhet, kjøp og salg av aksjer, eller på annen måte gjøre seg interessert i andre foretagender.

summary: AFNAN DENTAL AS (org. no. 997 686 977) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bærum, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2011-12-22. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 86.230 (Tannlegetjenester). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 4 167 496 and net income was NOK 13 907 272. CEO: Shoresh Afnan; board chair: Shoresh Afnan. Most recent dated item found (2026-07-02): "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts) – Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer. 15 dated news/announcement items are listed with source links.

conclusion.text: FAMILY FITNESS AS is an active private limited company in arts, entertainment and recreation, based in Kragerø. It has 36 registered employees and 1 registered establishments. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 6 670 787 and a profit of NOK 613 651, with positive equity of NOK 1 109 912. It has a registered CEO and board chair, and its 2025 accounts were audited. The most recent dated item found is "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts), published 2026-07-21 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer). No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution, negative equity, losses).

summary: FAMILY FITNESS AS (org. no. 977 466 407) is a private limited company (AS) based in Kragerø, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1997-04-21. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 93.130 (Treningssentervirksomhet); it has 36 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 6 670 787 and net income was NOK 613 651. CEO: Marte Husabø Hansen; board chair: Bjarne Vidar Borgan Paulsen. summary: CINDERELLA ECO GROUP AS (org. no. 998 619 408) is a private limited company (AS) based in Molde, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-07-16. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 22.240 (Produksjon av byggevarer av plast). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) operating revenue was NOK 2 655 491 and net income was NOK -895 600. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 265 403 566 (group accounts, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31). CEO: Gunhild Sjøvik; board chair: Odd Kjell Sjøvik; auditor: CEDRA NORGE AS. summary: COOP HORDALAND EIENDOM AS (org. no. 917 853 908) is a private limited company (AS) based in Bergen, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-10-10. The register states no bankruptcy, liquidation or compulsory dissolution. Its main activity is NACE 68.200 (Utleie av egen eller leid fast eiendom). In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) net income was NOK 208 648 084. Group (consolidated) revenue was NOK 121 709 208 (group accounts, period 2023-01-01/2023-12-31).
